D: A thirteen-year-old makes a birthday wish and wakes up as a thirty-year-old magazine editor.
P: Serve the snacks when Jenna gets the whole party dancing.
S: Jenna's disastrous thirteenth birthday in the basement
Gummy lollies, sour straps, jelly beans and chocolate buttons tipped into a big bowl for the party.
the wishing dust from Matt's dream house
Sugar cookies baked at 180C for 10 minutes, iced pale pink and dusted with edible glitter.
the Poise magazine party where Jenna starts the dance
Blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and chives, beside wedges of rockmelon wrapped in prosciutto, on silver trays.
M: Jenna going home to her parents
Chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and thyme at 200C for 75 minutes, with roast potatoes and green beans.
Jenna's grown-up life in New York
Egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, broccoli and capsicum in a sticky soy and honey sauce, in takeaway boxes.
W: Vanilla sponge baked at 175C for 30 minutes, iced with pink buttercream and covered in sprinkles, with thirteen candles.
K: Pineapple juice blended with coconut cream and ice, with a splash of white rum for the adults.

s.note: Jenna's disastrous thirteenth birthday in the basement
s.how: Tip 200g gummy lollies, 150g sour straps cut into pieces, 200g jelly beans and 100g chocolate buttons into a big bowl and toss together. Set it in the middle of the room for a thirteenth birthday party.

s.note: the wishing dust from Matt's dream house
s.how: Beat 200g butter with 150g sugar and an egg, then mix in 300g flour. Chill, roll and cut into rounds. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and cool. Ice pale pink with icing sugar and a drop of colouring, then dust with edible glitter like wishing dust.

m.note: Jenna's grown-up life in New York
m.how: Stir-fry 500g sliced chicken thighs until browned. Add broccoli florets and a sliced red capsicum and cook 3 minutes. Toss through 400g cooked egg noodles with soy sauce and honey until sticky. Pack into takeaway boxes.

w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake at 175C for 30 minutes and cool. Ice with pink buttercream made from butter and icing sugar, cover in sprinkles and add thirteen candles. Make a wish.

d.how: Blend 500ml pineapple juice with 200ml coconut cream and a big handful of ice until thick and smooth. Pour into glasses for the kids. Add 30ml white rum to each glass for the grown-ups who turned thirty overnight.
